rationale: The prompt requires Use these three papers to write related-work notes that compare approaches, show where they agree or diverge, and identify the gap my thesis targets; the anchored # Literature Review explicitly scopes the source-visible workflow to Produces a thematic literature review that organizes a field into an argument - consensus, disputes, evidence quality, and the open gap the reader should care about. Use when someone asks "write my related-work section". That scope directly supports the requested input, transformation, and deliverable rather than leaving a material component unaddressed.
